sources: pump.fun public trade API (swap-api.pump.fun/v2/coins/<mint>/trades): early tape (all sizes, first hours) + large-trade tape (>=1.0 SOL) per runner
kolscan.io/leaderboard public JSON (realized SOL profit, wins/losses, 1d/7d/30d)
Nansen labels already in data/nansen_crash_raw.json (no new Nansen calls)
public Solana RPC: getSignaturesForAddress(200) + getTransaction(30) per shortlisted wallet
method.score: 35 realized P&L (log, SOL) + 25 win rate (Bayesian (w+1)/(n+2) over runner positions + RPC closed positions + kolscan 30d) + 10 number of closed trades + 20 consistency (1 - best-token share of profits; positive across kolscan 1d/7d/30d) + 10 early on multiple runners
method.exclusions: first-slot buyers (bundle/dev = insider of own token) lose that runner; >=2 same-slot buy+sell round trips or >=150 trades on one runner = bot; >2500 tx/day; median hold <30s; Nansen labels MEV/Trading Bot/Deployer/Distributor/CEX

limits: Runner P&L only counts trades the tape captured: all early trades + trades >= 1.0 SOL later, so small later sells are missed (P&L is a lower bound for scalers-out).
RPC window = last 30 successful txs per wallet (hours to days); positions bought before the window are not scored.
kolscan covers ~90 KOL wallets only and its own P&L method; used as one input, not ground truth.
GMGN (Cloudflare 403), Birdeye (API key required, 401) and Cielo (login) were NOT used: not fetchable without login.
Base/BSC: no free per-wallet swap history without an API key (BscScan/Basescan need keys); GeckoTerminal only exposes the last 24h/300 trades per pool, so EVM lists are low-confidence.
